newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan trade surplus will not rise drastically-EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan trade surplus will not rise drastically-EPA.

text.p: Japan's trade surplus is unlikely to continue to grow as drastically as it did in May, Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Taro Aso told a news conference on Thursday.
"I don't think this trend will continue. I don't expect it to grow as much as it has been doing," Aso said.

Aso said that a surge in the trade surplus in May was due to special factors such as the weakness of the yen, lower oil prices, car trade and a drop in demand after an increase in Japan's consumption tax in April.
He said he did not think these special factors would continue.
